title: Les pluriels
en: Plurals: one table, two tables — and the exceptions
intro: Most French plurals just add a silent **-s**. But some words take **-x**, some change their ending, and a few change completely (*un œil → des yeux*). Here is the complete list of rules.

cases.label: most nouns: + s
cases.rule: Add **-s**: *une chaise → des chaises*. The **-s** is silent — you hear the plural in the article (*le / la → les*).

cases.label: -s, -x, -z: no change
cases.rule: Nouns already ending in **-s, -x, -z** stay the same: *un tapis → des tapis, un fils → des fils, un prix → des prix, un nez → des nez*.

cases.label: -eau, -eu: + x
cases.rule: Nouns in **-eau** and **-eu** add **-x**: *un bureau → des bureaux, un rideau → des rideaux, un jeu → des jeux*.

cases.label: -al → -aux
cases.rule: Nouns in **-al** change to **-aux**: *un journal → des journaux, un animal → des animaux*. You hear it: /a.ni.mal/ → /a.ni.mo/.

cases.label: -ou: + s (7 words + x)
cases.rule: Nouns in **-ou** add **-s** (*un trou → des trous*), except 7 that take **-x**: *bijou, caillou, chou, genou, hibou, joujou, pou* (*des bijoux*).

cases.label: irregular plurals
cases.rule: A few change completely: *un œil → des yeux, monsieur → messieurs, madame → mesdames*.

cases.label: adjectives follow the same rules
cases.rule: Adjectives agree too: *petit → petits, beau → beaux*. If they already end in **-s / -x**, no change: *vieux → vieux*.

sections.title: 1. Most nouns: add a silent -s

examples.fr: Il y a deux {chaises|plu-s} dans la cuisine.
examples.en: There are two chairs in the kitchen.
The beds are in the bedrooms.

sections.tip: You can't hear the **-s**, so listen for the article: *la chaise* /la/ → *les chaises* /le/. Before a vowel, you hear a link: *des‿armoires* /de.zaʁ.mwaʁ/.

examples.fr: Il y a trois {tapis|plu-same} dans le salon.
examples.en: There are three rugs in the living room.

sections.title: 3. -eau and -eu: add -x

examples.fr: Il y a des {tableaux|plu-x} au mur.
examples.en: There are paintings on the wall.

sections.tip: The **-x** is silent too: *bureau* and *bureaux* sound the same.

sections.title: 4. -al becomes -aux

examples.fr: Il y a des {journaux|plu-al} sur la table.
examples.en: There are newspapers on the table.

sections.tip: This plural you can **hear**. (A few exceptions just add **-s**, like *un festival → des festivals*.)

sections.title: 5. -ou: usually -s, but 7 words take -x

examples.fr: Il y a des {trous|plu-ou} dans le mur.
examples.en: There are holes in the wall.
The jewellery is in the wardrobe.

sections.tip: The 7 words with **-oux**: *bijou, caillou, chou, genou, hibou, joujou, pou* (jewel, pebble, cabbage, knee, owl, toy, louse). French children learn them by heart!

mistakes.why: The adjective is plural too: **beau → beaux**.

story.title: Le vide-grenier
story.en: Sunday flea market: Léa and Sophie shop for the new flat.

lines.fr: Dimanche, il y a un vide-grenier dans la rue.
lines.en: On Sunday there's a flea market in the street.

lines.fr: On vend des {meubles|plu-s}, des {jeux|plu-x}, des {bijoux|plu-ou} et des {journaux|plu-al}.
lines.en: People are selling furniture, games, jewellery and newspapers.

lines.fr: Regarde, Léa ! Des {rideaux|plu-x} pour nos fenêtres !
lines.en: Look, Léa! Curtains for our windows!

lines.fr: Bonjour, {mesdames|plu-irregular} ! J'ai aussi des {tableaux|plu-x} et des {bureaux|plu-x}.
lines.en: Hello, ladies! I also have paintings and desks.

lines.fr: Cinq euros. Et les {chaises|plu-s} sont à dix euros.
lines.en: Five euros. And the chairs are ten euros.

lines.fr: Oh, regarde : des petits {animaux|plu-al} en bois pour Lou !
lines.en: Oh, look: little wooden animals for Lou!

lines.fr: Salut, les filles ! Vous avez beaucoup de choses !
lines.en: Hi, girls! You've got lots of things!

lines.fr: Oui ! Des rideaux, deux tapis, une lampe… et des {bijoux|plu-ou} pour maman.
lines.en: Yes! Curtains, two rugs, a lamp… and jewellery for mum.

lines.fr: Pour toi, il y a des {jeux|plu-x} et des {journaux|plu-al} !
lines.en: For you, there are games and newspapers!

lines.fr: Le vendeur regarde Hugo avec de grands {yeux|plu-irregular}.
lines.en: The seller looks at Hugo with wide eyes.

quiz.q: Il y a deux ___ dans la cuisine.
quiz.en: There are two chairs in the kitchen.
The beds are in the bedroom.

quiz.q: What's the plural of « un tapis »?
Il y a deux ___ dans la classe.
quiz.en: There are two desks in the classroom.

quiz.q: Il y a des ___ sur la table.
quiz.en: There are newspapers on the table.
My mother has lots of jewellery.
quiz.why: **bijou** is one of the 7 words in **-ou** that take **-x**.

quiz.q: Il y a des ___ dans le mur.
quiz.en: There are holes in the wall.
